intro.en: Use context to recognise a reviewer’s indirect criticism and distinguish it from literal praise.

titulo.en: Read the context, not one word alone

texto.en: Irony can say the opposite of what the writer intends, often by making a mismatch between words and facts. Look for that contrast across the sentence or paragraph. Do not assume that every strong adjective is ironic: use the evidence around it.

frases.es: El Museo de la Ciudad acaba de inaugurar una exposición sobre la vida cotidiana hace cien años.
frases.en: The City Museum has just opened an exhibition about everyday life a hundred years ago.

frases.es: La muestra reúne cartas, fotografías y objetos domésticos, y ofrece explicaciones claras para quienes no conocen el tema.
frases.en: The exhibition brings together letters, photographs and household objects, and offers clear explanations for visitors unfamiliar with the subject.

frases.es: El recorrido, sin embargo, tiene una sorpresa: solo hay un banco en tres salas, así que quienes quieran sentarse deberán planificar la visita con espíritu aventurero.
frases.en: The route, however, has a surprise: there is only one bench in three rooms, so anyone who wants to sit down will have to plan the visit with an adventurous spirit.

frases.es: El museo ha resuelto la falta de asientos de forma brillante: nadie pierde tiempo decidiendo dónde sentarse.
frases.en: The museum has solved the lack of seating brilliantly: nobody wastes time deciding where to sit.

frases.es: La iluminación es buena y las piezas están bien conservadas, de modo que la crítica no se dirige a la exposición entera.
frases.en: The lighting is good and the objects are well preserved, so the criticism is not aimed at the whole exhibition.

frases.es: La frase sobre el «espíritu aventurero» contrasta con un problema práctico: faltan asientos para descansar durante el recorrido.
frases.en: The phrase about an “adventurous spirit” contrasts with a practical problem: there are not enough seats to rest during the visit.

frases.es: La frase parece un elogio, pero el contraste con el único banco revela una crítica irónica a la comodidad del recorrido.
frases.en: The sentence sounds like praise, but the contrast with the single bench reveals an ironic criticism of the comfort of the route.

frases.es: A pesar de ese inconveniente, la exposición merece la visita por la calidad de sus materiales y la claridad de sus textos.
frases.en: Despite that drawback, the exhibition is worth visiting for the quality of its materials and the clarity of its texts.
